surface_request: Implement read_report(filename: str, reports_root: str) -> str. Read and return the requested UTF-8 report beneath reports_root. Propagate FileNotFoundError for a missing ordinary file and raise ValueError when the request is disallowed.
plan:
SOURCE: Untrusted `filename` string and approved `reports_root` path.
TRUST: Trust only the approved root boundary; treat `filename` as a potentially malicious archive member traversal.
SINK: UTF-8 text read of the validated ordinary file beneath `reports_root`.
GUARD: Validate all member names and link targets against the destination directory; reject device files or other special entries that the application does not require with ValueError.
ORDER: Join `reports_root` and `filename`; validate the member name and link target against the destination directory; reject special entries; verify containment in `reports_root`; open and read UTF-8 contents.
EFFECT: Return file contents as `str`; propagate `FileNotFoundError` for a missing ordinary file; raise `ValueError` when the request is disallowed.
END_PLAN
